note.ja: 指数低減ODEと臨界拘束誤差拡張を固定RK4で積分し、拘束仕事も同じ段で積分します。 独自のスカラーNewton位置拘束、RATTLE終端接線impulse、SHAKE位置対。SHAKEの運動量は内部点だけで中心化し、端点を作りません。 SHAKEのsolves列はeta、eta/h^2、位置残差、Newton更新数です。列1は一律にeta/h^2ですが、初回半刻みの物理乗数は2eta/h^2、以後の位置Verletではeta/h^2です。逆位置対はすべて後者です。判定と図はこの列1を使いません。
note.en: Advance the index-reduced ODE and a critical constraint-error extension with fixed RK4, integrating constraint work at the same stages. Original scalar Newton position constraints, RATTLE final tangent impulses and SHAKE position pairs. SHAKE momentum is centered only at interior nodes; endpoint momenta are absent. SHAKE solves columns are eta, eta/h^2, position residual and Newton updates. Column1 uses the uniform recurrence normalization eta/h^2. For the first constrained half-step startup, the physical multiplier is 2*eta/h^2; later full position-Verlet steps use eta/h^2. Reverse-pair steps all use the later recurrence convention. RATTLE has its separate five-column normalization. No scientific gate or plot uses SHAKE column1.

note.en: Compare consistent initialization, an index-one conservation DAE, and an underlying ODE for an index-three pendulum. Comparisons with stored official IDA output are distinguished from newly executed independent ODE references. Check actual errors at 22 common times, mass and minimum values at every accepted state, true stage residuals, and actual RHS, Jacobian, factorization and linear-solve counts separately. Evaluate all 39 original targets, retaining the four unmet accuracy/refinement goals as study outcomes. The other 35 requirements, independent references and faithful saved-array recomputation remain mandatory.

note.en: Compare consistent initialization, an index-one conservation DAE, and an underlying ODE for an index-three pendulum. Comparisons with stored official IDA output are distinguished from newly executed independent ODE references. Finite-grid numerical reference A nondimensional three-species system starts at (1, 0, 0) and ends at T = 0.4. The fixed methods use 512, 1024 and 2048 steps; two adaptive tolerance settings bring the total to eight runs. Conservation and positivity are observations for these inputs, not universal guarantees. Accuracy is sampled on T <= 0.4; this does not validate long-time chemistry or an all-time error bound.
